subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should OpenClaw own this custom cooperative glob resolver as the permanent implementation for existing bootstrap-extra-files configurations?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, proof-positive, and has no actionable defect, but it replaces Node dependency behavior in a compatibility- and session-context-sensitive path; repository policy requires explicit owner judgment for that permanent boundary.
